title: Evolution of the initial distribution volume of glucose in the severe burned adults
official: INDICIA: evolution of the initial distribution volume of glucose in the severe burned adults
summary: Main objective: Description of the mean values of the initial volume of glucose distribution (IDVG) during the first four days of management of a severely burned patient.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients over 18 years of age
2. Patients hospitalized with burns of at least 30% of body surface area o By a thermal mechanism o At the CHR Metz-Thionville burn center o managed within the 8 hours post-burn
3. Patient affiliated to a social security scheme
4. Written consent obtained from the patient (or from the trusted person, family or relatives if the patient is unable to sign/express consent) or emergency inclusion if the patient is unable to express consent and neither the trusted support person nor any member of the family or relatives is present at the time of inclusion
Exclusion criteria:
1. Diabetic patients on insulin
2. Cognitive impairment or language barrier
3. Patient with a CONTRAINDICATION to GLUCOSE 30% PROAMP, solution for injection
4. Patients with pre-hospital cardiac arrest
5. Patient with extra corporeal circulation : Extra Corporeal Membranous Oxygenation (ECMO) or Extra Corporeal Life Support (ECLS) or CRRT (Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy)
6. Patient without central venous line or arterial catheter
7. Patient moribund or immediately subject to therapeutic limitation
8. Impossibility of trans-pulmonary thermodilution monitoring (vascular access difficulties)
9. Pregnant, parturient or breast-feeding women
10. Patient under guardianship, curatorship or safeguard of justice
